evidence.quote: All but one member concluded that it would be appropriate to begin reinvesting principal received from agency debt and MBS held in the SOMA by purchasing longer-term Treasury securities
the Committee would need to consider steps it could take to provide additional policy stimulus if the outlook were to weaken appreciably further.
Many said they expected underlying inflation to stay, for some time, below levels they judged most consistent with the dual mandate to promote maximum employment and price stability.
Many policymakers judged that downside risks to the U.S. recovery had become somewhat larger
most saw the incoming data as indicating that the economy was operating farther below its potential than they had thought, that the pace of recovery had slowed in recent months
members generally saw both employment and inflation as likely to fall short of levels consistent with the dual mandate for longer than had been anticipated.

parsed.rationale: The minutes describe a weakening recovery, low inflation with rising disinflation risk, a shift to reinvesting MBS principal to avoid tightening, and discussion of additional stimulus. Only one dissenter favored removing accommodation, so the net signal is clearly dovish.
